index.headline: Subscription Manager
index.title: Manage your tasks wisely
index.description: A simple and powerful task manager that helps you focus on what matters most. Create, organize, and complete tasks—all in one place.
index.dashboard_description: A central screen for quick expense control and payment planning. All key metrics are gathered in one place.

first.title: Key metrics
first.description: displays the total number of subscriptions, the most expensive subscription, and the average cost.

second.title: Calendar with write-off amounts
second.description: visualization of payments by days of the current month with indication of amounts.

third.title: Annual expenditure schedule
third.description: Line chart of monthly expenses and total for 12 months.

index.table_description: A complete list of all services with the ability to add, edit, and delete entries. Easy sorting and searching.

first.title: Adding a new subscription
first.description: form with fields: service, cost, currency, period (month/year), date of first write-off.

second.title: Editing and deleting
second.description: Linear editing or modal windows, database synchronization.

third.title: Sorting and searching
third.description: Quick filtering by name, price, period and next payment date.

settings.currency_description: Used for totals and aggregate amounts.
settings.email_description: Used, to sign in, for email receipts.
settings.password_description: Confirm your current password before setting a new one.
settings.delete_account_description: Once you delete your account, there is no going back. Please be certain.
